children: Aon announced the issuance of $14.0 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes to fund the USI acquisition and related purposes.
Issuers sold $14.0B of senior unsecured notes across seven series with coupons from 5.350% to 6.450% and maturities 2029–2056.
Notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Aon and related guarantors on a senior unsecured basis.
Net proceeds ~ $13.4008B to be used for USI acquisition cash consideration, repay USI indebtedness and pay related fees.
If the USI deal fails by specified deadlines, Issuers must redeem USI Acquisition Notes at 101% of principal (plus accrued interest).
